'''Monika Hilker''' (born 24 March 1959 in [[Friesoythe]], [[Germany]])<ref name="old_cv">{{cite web |title=Curriculum Vitae (Prof. Dr. Monika Hilker) |date=25 November 2011 |url=http://www2.biologie.fu-berlin.de/azoet/hilker/cv.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120614200704/http://www2.biologie.fu-berlin.de/azoet/hilker/cv.html |archive-date=14 June 2012 |access-date=31 July 2018}}</ref> is a biologist and a professor at the [[Freie Universität Berlin]]. She leads the Applied Zoology/Animal Ecology working group at the Freie Universität, studying the [[chemical ecology|chemical]] and [[molecular ecology]] of [[plant]]-[[insect]] interactions.<ref name="lab_website" /><ref>{{cite news |last1=Koechlinn |first1=Florianne |title=Auch Bäume brauchen Bodyguards |url=https://www.woz.ch/-75ed |accessdate=31 July 2018 |work=Die Wochenzeitung |issue=1/2017 |date=5 January 2017}}</ref> She is also the speaker and director of the Collaborative Research Centre (CRC) 973 "Priming and Memory of Organismic Responses to Stress".<ref name="lab_website">{{cite web |url=http://www.bcp.fu-berlin.de/biologie/arbeitsgruppen/zoologie/ag_hilker/index.html |title=Applied Zoology / Animal Ecology - Fachbereich Biologie, Chemie, Pharmazie|date=25 November 2011 |accessdate=31 July 2018}}</ref>

==Education==
Hilker received a [[Diplom#Germany|Diploma]] in biology (forest zoology) at the [[University of Göttingen]] in 1983. Her research focused on visual and olfactory orientation in [[bark beetles]]. In the same year, she completed a teacher examination in [[organic chemistry]] at the same university. She remained at the University of Göttingen to conduct research on pheromones that deter oviposition in [[moths]], receiving her doctoral degree ([[Dr. rer. nat.]]) in 1986. She completed her [[Habilitation]] (Dr. habil.) in zoology and animal ecology at the [[University of Bayreuth]] in 1993, working with [[Chrysomelidae|leaf beetles]].<ref name="new_cv">{{cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Monika Hilker - Applied Zoology / Animal Ecology - Fachbereich Biologie, Chemie, Pharmazie |date=June 2012 |url=http://www.bcp.fu-berlin.de/biologie/arbeitsgruppen/zoologie/ag_hilker/Team/Head/hilker/index.html |accessdate=31 July 2018}}</ref>

==Career==

From 1987 to 1994, Hilker worked as an assistant professor at the University of Bayreuth. In 1994, she accepted a job as a full professor at the Freie Universität Berlin. Hilker served as a member of the [[Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft|DFG]] (German Research Foundation) senate from 2003 to 2009.<ref>{{cite web |title=Pressemitteilung Nr. 28 - 1. Juli 2009 |url=https://www.dfg.de/service/presse/pressemitteilungen/2009/pressemitteilung_nr_28/index.html |website=Neue Gesichter im DFG-Senat|accessdate=31 July 2018}}</ref> She was an associate editor for the ''[[Journal of Chemical Ecology]]'' from 2004 to 2013<ref name="new_cv" /><ref>{{cite web |title=About ISCE |url=https://www.chemecol.org/aboutISCE.shtml |website=International Society of Chemical Ecology|accessdate=31 July 2018}}</ref> and served as vice president (2009-2010) and then president (2010-2011) of the [[International Society of Chemical Ecology]].<ref name="new_cv" /> She has also been involved in initiatives to promote young researchers and women in science.<ref>{{cite web |title=Mitglieder der Kommission zur Förderung von Nachwuchswissenschaftlerinnen (KFN) |url=https://www.fu-berlin.de/sites/frauenbeauftragte/organisation/kfn/mitglieder/index.html |website=Freie Universität Berlin|accessdate=31 July 2018}}</ref>
